Love loan gone wrong; Judge Judy schools teen parents on growing up.
Tenant claims her landlord placed a bug in her bedroom; dog owner claims stud failed to perform and wants her fee back.
Would-be groom wants money back; woman denies retaliating against family.
Does Dad owe for son's repo'd truck?; who made the long distance phone calls?
Grandson denies stealing from his grandma.
Man claims he made a ring for his biker buddy and was never paid; pool supply owner sues cue maker.
Woman claims she was assaulted when she told a Hollywood electronic store worker that his film was too expensive.
Man upset his mom was buried in his plot; ex-wives fight over late husband's car.
Child denies pulling dog's ears; woman claims she bailed her friend's boyfriend out of jail twice and hasn't been paid back.

This courtroom series stars former family court judge Judy Sheindlin. Each episode finds Judge Judy presiding over real small-claims cases inside a televised courtroom. Her no-nonsense, wisecracking approach has been unsuccessfully copied by other TV court judges.
Boss denies harassing employee.
Neighbors argue over towed truck.
High School Halloween showdown lands in court; underage drinking ends in a wrecked car.
Couple loaned favorite waiter money; woman crashed boyfriend's motorcycle.
Exes fight over game show prizes; woman accused of throwing ex's stuff to the curb.
Real estate agent denies breaking into woman's home.
Son denies stealing mom's bank card; cop paid for dancer's augmentation surgery, now wants the money back.
Would-be adoptive couple sues after birth mother changed her mind.
Daughter sues late dad's common-law wife over inheritance; man claims ex was leading him on.
Woman claims her ex-boyfriend assaulted her, but he claims it was self-defense.
Landlord denies hosing down woman's living room furniture.
Woman claims man convinced her to move away with him saying he would propose, but never did; man claims ex-girlfriend won't return his possessions, but still sends her love letters.
Judge Judy does some detective work mid-case; longtime friends fight, but root of issue is debated.
Woman says child's father broke her radio; ex-husband claims he paid his fair share of debt.
Man denies saying he'd "take care" of car bill; "charming" boyfriend won woman over.
Woman claims ex deserted her in the desert after she put money down on a house; Couple argues over discs, debt, and driving dangerously.
Woman claims a rabbit attacked her at a petting zoo; Aspen trip turns into debt drama.
Man sues dating service over matches they made.
Man sues ex over spring break vacation; man claims money for car was a gift.
Woman sues friend's mom for using credit card; man invites two exes to live with him.
Man's car stolen at the club.
Soon-to-be exes debate precious mementoes; should friend pay for the parking ticket?
Neighbors at war over nasty letter and typewriter.
Apartment manager accused of getting physical with a building visitor.
Woman denies keying former coworker's car; man claims he was fired after telling coworker to stop calling his sister.
Grandpa wants child support from his son.
Sisters fight over mother's estate; man claims his neighbor ran a truck over his lawn, causing his cesspool to cave in.
Man claims ex is infatuated with him; woman claims her ex agreed to make payments on a jet ski, but stopped when they broke up.
Ex wants bail money back; teen denies vandalizing neighbor's property.
Man denies throwing tantrums over mall gifts; son gets evicted when dad goes to jail.
Couple suing for a refund after sensual therapy seminar.
Dad fights boyfriend over missing daughter; did a favor for a friend put a woman in debt?
Mother-in-law wants her appliances back; who should pay for son's broken hand?
Woman claims driver ran her off the road, totaling her truck and knocking her out.
Whose couch is it anyway?; ex-friends battle over concert tickets.
Woman sues for child support for runaway; car repair claim.
Landlord denies trying to date tenant; neighbors deny stealing florist's bicycle.
Three thousand dollars ends a friendship; family feuds over mother's ashes.
Daughter sues dad over rare antiques; woman vomited on cousin's fake fur coat.
Firebird feud; pet fish eaten at party?
Woman pregnant with ex-boyfriend's baby claims he owes her money; Man refuses to pay son's funeral costs.
Cook denies harassing restaurant hostess.
Boots, bling, and babysitting beef; the case of the missing money orders.
Busted window, busted friendship, busted VCR; matchmaker made no match.
Who owes for Porsche repairs?; harmonica virtuoso claims restaurant owner didn't pay him for his performance.
Prison guard denies mistreating former inmate and claims she slandered him on the internet.
Besties break up for Vail trip and crushed hat; child basketball prank ends with an ER visit.
Exes spin into court over tire rims; bikini models claim they weren't paid.
Man bought tools on woman's charge card; dog falls off deck after getting spooked by cat.
Did barmaid borrow money, or was it a gift?; family denies misusing disability checks.
Woman denies skipping out on rent.
Man takes ex-wife to court over daughter's lip piercing and karate lessons; woman sues friend for repairs on a truck she wanted to buy, but never got.
Teen driver denies terrorizing neighborhood.
Babysitter denies lying about her past and wants back pay.
Friend denies telling dancer's parents about her job; busted window, furious roommates.
Woman sues ex for medical expenses; woman sues former fiancé for the wedding they planned and more.
Man claims his landlord and building manager refused to return his rent, and moved someone else in while he was still living there.
Who hit a man with a skateboard?
Stepdad denies trashing woman's baby pictures; woman wants money for her cross-stitch.
Grandma sues for bail, child support and more; model says agent didn't do anything.
In part two, an employer counters his ex-employees' lawsuit with a 10K claim against them for slander and for filing a false complaint.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first, an errant lap dance leads to a heated argument between roommates which escalates into an alleged dog attack and vandalized furniture. In the second case, after receiving a large settlement, a young man invests thousands in his longtime friend's podcast. A case of Covid and differing artistic opinions leave them fighting over equipment.
A musician demands recognition and payment for his creative work on a song; he sues for the 10K court maximum for breach of contract.
An electrical contractor sues for the 10K court maximum for negative online business reviews that he claims hurt his business; he is countersued for 10K for allegedly filing a frivoulous lawsuit.

programmes.t: DUI Slam into House and Covid Cancel
programmes.d: The Judge presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman is trapped in her home with her terrified dog for hours after an impaired driver crashes through the wall. In the second case, when a destination wedding is cancelled due to COVID, a young woman uses refunded airline vouchers. The bride-to-be says she paid for them, and they should have been returned to her.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, a woman is accused of repeatedly backing into a teen's car in her own driveway; her daughter testifies against her. In the 2nd case, a man alleges that at the sight of two growling pit bulls on his front porch, he retreated to the safety of his new car. He says the dogs proceeded to bite and scratch his week-old, luxury vehicle.
A tenant's violation of pool rules leads a property manager to take drastic action. The tenant then sues for an alleged assault, attorney fees and emotional distress.
After the bars close, drinking continues in a park but ends when a flying beer can causes thousands in dental damages to a partygoer. Former high school teammates fight over who is to blame.

In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, the Judge shares memories of her own childhood dance experience while mediating a payment dispute between a dance studio owner and a single mother. In the second case, a woman says her roommate's boyfriend entered their shared apartment unannounced and with his own key. She claims the voicing of her safety concerns led to her eviction.
A woman claims her former employer accused her of being a drug addict and withheld wages. Her employer countersues for defamation of character.
A failed attempt at living together leaves sisters in a bitter dispute over alleged child neglect, a mysterious call to CPS and police intervention after a lockout.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a Father's Day standoff between a teenager and his girlfriends' stepsister ends with the violent smashing of a car mirror. In the second, a man admits that he was only present during the euthanization of a beloved pet because his ex-girlfriend said she would forgive a debt if he provided emotional support.
A spa owner sues a former employee for the 10k court maximum claiming that the aesthetician broke their non-compete agreement and started working well within the seven-mile radius of her business.

Despite being slapped with a restraining order for threatening his ex son-in-law, a grandfather continues to seek payback from him. An eviction, marital debt and care for his grandchildren come into play.

In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a high school teacher accuses a student of a hit-and-run; the teen's father is reprimanded for allowing his uninsured teen to drive without a license. In the second case, after a woman's business is shut down by the government due to Covid, ex-roommates accuse each other of taking advantage of the rental relief program.
A landlord's new property comes complete with previous tenants who sue him for child endangerment due to alleged lead poisoning. The landlord countersues when they stop paying rent.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a hair-salon owner helps a friend pay for a luxury vehicle which he proceeds to crash; instead of paying her back, he then buys an expensive electric sports car. In the second case, A man accuses his ex-friend of repossessing his car without just cause and demands payback for the 5K he put into it.
An unlicensed contractor sues for damages after a married couple stops payment on a $4200 check for demolition work. They accuse him of property theft and dispute payment for a tractor rental.

A man accuses his sister of kidnapping his special-needs teenager who was, unbeknownst to him, in need of life-saving, emergency brain surgery. The sister is seeking reimbursement for costs associated with that surgery and return of her nephew’s property.

In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, years after the death of their mother, sisters fight over the disbursement details of her personal belongings. A woman says she only wants one photo with her mother as a keepsake. In the second case, an independent contractor on disability sues an old friend for an unpaid loan and money allegedly stolen from their joint bank account.

Police body-cam footage captures a woman's admission and regret that her pit bull attacked a neighbor's miniature schnauzer. Her actions after the attack tell a different story when pictures surface that show her off-leash pit bull roaming the neighborhood.
An amateur pilot sues for the 10K court maximum when his plane is allegedly damaged by a certified flight instructor who hit an object on the runway. Damning video evidence comes into play.

programmes.t: One-Wheel Whammy and All Bets Are Off
programmes.d: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a teenager on a one-wheel, electric skateboard plows into the side of a car, flies onto the hood and falls to the ground. Lucky to be alive, he now faces a motorist suing for vehicle damages. In the next case, a single father wins a $36,000 sports gambling payout and gives his ex-roommate 6K to 'hold' for him. She claims it was a gift.

Both parties seek the 10K court maximum when a man's death brings to light the fact that he was never married to his 'wife'. Family members and his estranged 'partner' fight over an allegedly false police report and personal property.

A woman is lured into an ill-conceived 'intervention' at a friend's home by being told she will receive drugs once she gets there. She is sued for breaking a TV in a fit of rage, but countersues for damages caused by the emotional trauma she suffered.

Scrappy the French Bulldog makes an appearance in court when a woman sues her kickboxer exboyfriend for custody of their shared pet. The Judge admonishes them for making a long-term pet decision in a short-term relationship.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, when a plumber sues an employer for filing an allegedly false restraining order, the Judge must decide if an ominous voicemail was cause enough for the complaint. In the second case, long after a relationship ends, dueling text messages help the Judge decipher the facts about a disputed loan between ex-lovers.

In this two-part episode, a man fears for his safety and leaves his home when six men show up to defend his roommate during a heated argument. He returns the next day to find his room has been thoroughly vandalized.
In part two, a woman claims she was framed for vandalism and falsely arrested. She seeks compensation for slashed tires and alleged cyberbullying.
When divorced parents sue each other for the 10k court maximum, a teenager is caught in the middle of a feud over a 'maliciously' towed vehicle and multiple reports to child services.

In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a man with 4 children by 3 different women is at the center of a fight between two of the mothers. He remains silent while they fight over harassment, alleged gun-brandishing and vandalism. In the 2nd case, a bride only offers $50 to her planner who paid thousands to help make sure her California ranch wedding took place during the pandemic.
A fight breaks out between female veterinary workers and a passionate pet owner in seek of emergency care for his injured cat. He sues for damages after receiving a black eye in the parking lot.
A woman's demand that her 4K security deposit be returned is marred by the fact that she took the doorbell with her when she left.
In this two-part episode, a cosmetics salesman is accused of accosting and holding a woman captive for hours plying her with compliments and free samples.
In part two, the customer 'escapes' by purchasing an $8,000 rejuvenation wand and sues for fraud soon after.

After 'kidnapping' her own child from a family member and evading police, a woman is charged with child endangerment and spends four months in jail. She accuses her mother of stealing thousands from her while she was imprisoned.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman loans 10K to a new friend to support his supplement business; he claims it was an investment in a plan to sell 'happy pills' at festivals. Up next, a single mother with four children and good credit sues for 10k when her stepfather reneges on a car deal. She is left with payments for 2 vehicles and a dwindling credit score.
Six years of peace and harmony between divorcees come to an abrupt halt when three ATVs and a $58,000 truck are at stake.

When a young man is caught cheating three times, he is expelled from school. His steadfast father reverses charges for his son's tuition and is now faced with a lawsuit by administration for doing so.
When neighbors feud over property and attorney fees, the Judge shares her own personal story about a neighbor who refused to amicably resolve an easement issue.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first, an online influencer seeks the 10K court maximum from a tailor he claims botched the creation of his dream costume. The 'ill-fitting' ensemble is modelled in court by its disgruntled owner. Up next, a caregiver takes $400 from a 90-year-old dementia patient because 'she told me to.' After her patient suffers a fall, she is dismissed.
To avoid points on his driving record, a trucker offers cash to a fellow motorist after an accident. Their arrangement falls apart when repair estimate amounts and dates vary wildly.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman makes a deposit on a foal six months before its birth but wants out of the contract once the animal is born. Believing the baby horse could not be insured, she sues for breach of contract. In the second case, a disabled veteran sues for a $6500 refund when the paint job on her beloved 1969 VW Volkswagen starts 'bubbling'.
A man is sued for property damage to a $1400 a month pool house with no indoor plumbing. He claims his landlord assaulted him in a fight over unpaid utilities and disrespect.

In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, after a popular medical student tragically drowns, his friends raise over 40K in his honor. His mother and sister fight over his property and the funds collected. Next, a woman denies being under the influence of anything other than Benadryl when she slams into a parked car and pushes it 25 feet down a sidewalk. She is sued for damages.
An ex-con's fresh start with his wife in a new home is marred by their landlords' lawsuit over property damage, unpaid rent and defamation. A missing claw-foot tub comes into play.

In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a mother and son are no longer on speaking terms after a deal to purchase a van falls apart. He claims the inoperable van was a gift and that any discussion of money was only to appease her after the fact. In the next case, a mechanical engineer and a programmer fight over profits from their shared cryptocurrency mining business.
A not-so-neighborly dog walk results in vandalism and police intervention. A woman sues for a false arrest, lawyer fees and damages caused by the trauma of a night in jail.

In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a man changes his story many times when asked to prove that monies loaned to him by an ex were never meant to be paid back. In the next case, following their break-up, a man loans the mother of his child 10K to escape the burden of 500-800% interest rates on her personal debt. They fight over payback when a new boyfriend comes into play.

Both parties seek the 10K court maximum when a real-estate purchase 10 miles south of the border goes awry. A new homeowner is accused of illegally evicting the previous owner and extorting her for money by holding her pets as ransom.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a victim of a hit-and-run makes the split-second decision to slam her car into a house instead of oncoming traffic. Her actions may have saved lives, but she is sued for property damage by a homeowner. Up next, an alcohol-fueled altercation over a cheating girlfriend leaves friends at odds over an alleged assault and two kayaks.
Two large dogs set their sights on a 38-foot, inflatable, obstacle course and chew into a portion of the structure. Business partners seek compensation for damages to their party rental equipment.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a 21-year-old drives her guardian's car without permission, crashes and totals the vehicle leaving family members to fight over damages. Up next, former gambling buddies fight over a jackpot win, missing jewelry and a little white lie to a boyfriend about where the grocery money went.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first, both parties seek the 10K court maximum when old friends fight over an RV escalates into a physical assault. Up next, new parents hire an event planner to organize a Sip n' See celebration of their newborn child. The planner backs out when jealousy and threats surface; she is sued for a refund.

Bad blood between unwed parents leads to a fight over a three-year-old car accident and an attempt to collect far more than the car is worth. Jail time, alleged domestic violence and admitted drug use come into play.
In a small Idaho farming community, a teenager sells four piglets to a neighbor and expects to be paid in full. The buyer claims all four animals died and that he owes nothing.

An unlikely friendship develops between a male nurse and a female inmate through a prison pen pal program. Soon after her release, their once-supportive relationship devolves into a fight over stimulus checks and a car loan.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, despite eye-witness testimony, a man insists that his unlicensed girlfriend was not driving his truck when it backed into a neighbor's house. His teenage son backs up his story. Next, a mechanic refuses to return a woman's wrecked car until he is paid; she admits to spending insurance money intended for car repairs on her own personal expenses.
A senior victim of bank fraud seeks restitution from her teenage, great granddaughter who made the mistake of accepting mysterious checks from an ex-con relative.
Teenagers who met in foster care get into a catfight over a boy. Their fight escalates into an aggressive act of caught-on-tape vandalism, an arrest and a 10K lawsuit.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. First, a young woman breaks up with her live-in boyfriend and starts to date their new roommate. The ex-boyfriend sues the happy new couple for $10K and for the return of his two cats. Next, business partners pay $6K to rent a party space for teens; they sue for breach of contract when event restrictions are put in place without their approval.

A man is sued for alleged failure to pay his late mother's caregiver. He accuses the healthcare worker of contributing to the 'delinquency of an elderly patient' by giving his dying mother cigarettes and marijuana.

A 14-year-old girl steals her mother's car, goes on a joyride and T-bones an unsuspecting motorist on her way to work. The teenager runs from the crash site; the injured motorist leaves in an ambulance.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. Up first, while attending a friend's birthday party, a teenager accidentally breaks an outdoor sprinkler. Her actions, caught on security footage, cause $9K in flooding throughout an apartment building. In the next case, after inheriting her late brother's home, a woman triples the rent on his remaining tenant and sues him for alleged property damage.
In this two-part episode, a woman who suffered abuse as a child is convinced her neighbor is guilty of neglect and reports her to DCS multiple times.
In part two, the Judge must decide if a woman's allegations are justified as feuding neighbors sue for the 10k court maximum over an alleged assault and shocking charges of child endangerment.

Former army buddies pool their resources to purchase one luxury vehicle in order to start a car rental business. A doomed rental ends with the vehicle being wrecked, their insurance being dropped and thousands in damage.

A young widow with a newborn baby claims her deceased husband’s best friend stole money from his account. The best friend defends his actions passionately and says the money went to a GoFundMe set up for his children.
To make ends meet, young parents decide to sell their pets. They immediately regret their decision and fight for the return of one of their dogs.
To compensate for lost playing time during Covid, a devoted father pays a basketball coach $8500 to start up a team for his son. He sues for damages when the team falls apart.

A man claims he was falsely arrested after a road rage incident in which he was accused of wielding a gun. The victim of his alleged fury submits her frantic 911 call claiming a gunshot can be heard in the background.
A battle of bad online reviews is waged in rural Michigan between a pet daycare business and a water supply company.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, divorcees fight over the fate of $10k in tools: he says she had no right to sell his deceased father's equipment; she says the mortgage had to be paid, and they only sold for $1K. Up next, "Dulce" the Goldendoodle puppy suffers a broken leg while in the care of a new dog sitter who is accused of leaving the pet alone with a child.
Estranged parents fight over their teenager's cell phone, sporting events and a trip to Portugal.

In this two-part episode, a woman does her boss a favor by dropping off lunch to her home only to be attacked by her pit bull the moment she steps through the doorway. The terrifying attack is caught on video.
In part two, after a pit-bull attack, the dog's owner insists that the victim was given fair warning and told not to enter the home.

While riding a scooter together, a man and his son are hit by a truck and thrown to the ground; the father sues the driver for damages but soon finds himself in the hot seat over his handling of the scooter.
After a failed attempt at living together, sisters fight over property damage and the alleged theft of over $14k from their grandmother's inheritance.

In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a German Shepherd digs under a fence, enters a neighbor's house and kills their baby Macaw. The dog’s owner says they should have had a stronger fence. In the next case, a woman faces an uphill battle trying to collect on a loan from her granddaughter's father. The Judge is appalled by how he treats the woman raising his 12-year-old child.

A youth baseball umpire sues for the $10K court maximum after being violently attacked by a coach whose team was disqualified for fielding illegal players. The umpire's son stepped in to defend his father, only to become the target of an attack by angry parents.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, a woman sues a motorist for destroying her parked vehicle in a catastrophic five-car accident. Video reveals the harrowing collision, the near-death of a pedestrian and the car at fault. Next, after the tragic death of her daughter, a grandmother sues her ex daughter-in-law over money raised at a spaghetti fundraiser for her grandchildren.
A 20-year-old with four young children seeks emotional distress compensation when an acquaintance of her incarcerated husband allegedly embarks on a campaign of harassment and defamation.

When a relationship ends, a woman seeks payback of money loaned to help her ex-boyfriend in his custody battle. He countersues, claiming she sent a doctored video to his workplace that got him fired and orchestrated a smear campaign that jeopardized his parental rights.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, after four weeks of dating, a woman is persuaded to invest $10K in a car-flipping venture. She fights to recover her investment when the relationship ends, and the business fails. Next, a man drives cross country to help an entrepreneur sell her beard-care products at a fair. Their collaboration ends in a battle over 78 jars of merchandise.
When jealousy sparks a heated argument between two women vying for the same man, a legal battle ensues, fueled by car vandalism and escalating threats.
A contentious landlord-tenant dispute escalates when two men file dueling restraining orders and sue each other over a security deposit, emotional distress, and harassment.

A jointly-owned vehicle is at the center of the conflict between a man and his current and past girlfriend, both of whom share children with him. Missed payments, insurance lapses, and damages from an accident further complicate the dispute.
In this two-part episode, a disabled veteran turned music entrepreneur sues one of 'Atlanta’s top performers’ for the $10K court maximum.
When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.
Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race.
A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.
A loyal dog and a vigilante cat embark on a space age voyage to find their way home.

A rookie race-car driver gets the opportunity to compete against the reigning champion. With help from a former driver, he must overcome treacherous terrain, rival racers and unexpected obstacles to prove he has what it takes.

A cat named Blanket lives in the city with his son, Cape. One day, Cape decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past.
When his beloved Queen bee Marguerite is kidnapped, vagabond cricket Apollo who has been framed for the crime, teams up with the other bugs to save the Queen and the entire kingdom.
A boy at risk of being sent to boarding school by his Dad - and three aliens stranded due to watching too much TV - must help each other out.

After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy

Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!
When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.
Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race.
A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.
A loyal dog and a vigilante cat embark on a space age voyage to find their way home.

A rookie race-car driver gets the opportunity to compete against the reigning champion. With help from a former driver, he must overcome treacherous terrain, rival racers and unexpected obstacles to prove he has what it takes.

A cat named Blanket lives in the city with his son, Cape. One day, Cape decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past.
When his beloved Queen bee Marguerite is kidnapped, vagabond cricket Apollo who has been framed for the crime, teams up with the other bugs to save the Queen and the entire kingdom.
A boy at risk of being sent to boarding school by his Dad - and three aliens stranded due to watching too much TV - must help each other out.

Gary y Josh no regresan de una búsqueda rutinaria de combustible y los núcleos de perforación ponen en duda la calidad de las lentes de jade en 2 Mile.
La tripulación finalmente logra un gran éxito, pero con el invierno acercándose, a Claudia le preocupa que el gran hallazgo haya llegado demasiado tarde.
Claudia está desesperada por comenzar a minar, pero las brutales condiciones del camino la hacen preguntarse si la tripulación logrará llegar a su reclamo.
Mientras Guy y Gary se apresuran a arreglar el camino destrozado hacia el reclamo, Claudia espera que un nuevo miembro de la tripulación sea el billete de la suerte.
La juerga de compras sorpresa de Robin estresa a Claudia cuando sus errores de compra retrasan la temporada minera.
Claudia intenta mantener la paz cuando Robin y su padre chocan, mientras el equipo lucha por solucionar un problema tras otro en su camión minero.
Gary y Josh están frustrados por una serie de crisis, mientras Claudia hace un anuncio impactante que descarrila los planes de Robin y provoca un conflicto entre la pareja.
Tensions boil over between Robin, Josh and Steve about how to mine and when Claudia steps in, things get downright explosive.
Plagados de problemas con los camiones, Robin y su equipo corren para hacer un suministro de combustible antes de que el equipo se agote.
Robin choca con Claudia y Josh por la calidad del jade que sale de su pozo, mientras que el intento de Larry de ayudar a llevar el barracón de la tripulación al campamento fracasa.
Claudia y su equipo están decididos a seguir minando a pesar de los incendios forestales que arden alrededor de su reclamo, hasta que las cosas empeoran y tienen que correr para salir.
Después de perder dos semanas de minería en los incendios forestales, Claudia y Robin corren el riesgo de regresar a Two Mile y apostar por la apertura de un nuevo pozo.
Claudia se estresa tratando de preparar su mejor jade para los compradores, mientras la moral de su equipo se pone a prueba mientras luchan contra el frío.
Claudia hace todo lo posible para intentar hacer una gran venta a los compradores de jade, mientras en la mina Guy y Gary luchan contra la primera tormenta de nieve de la temporada.
Claudia presiona a su equipo para que siga minando a pesar de las gélidas temperaturas y el deterioro de las condiciones de las carreteras.
La temporada de Claudia comienza con fuerza cuando recibe un pedido de jade por valor de 250 000 dólares.
Después de años de obtener la parte dura del trato con Scrappy Larry, Robin le hace una broma a su viejo amigo.
Bajo presión para cumplir con el ajustado plazo de su comprador, Robin y Josh chocan cuando se topan con interminables problemas.
Cuando una avería grave amenaza con cerrar la mina, Claudia y Robin toman la arriesgada decisión.
Josh evita por poco el desastre al entrar a la mina con una carga de combustible y Claudia queda devastada.
Claudia y Robin se apresuran a encontrar una segunda roca de jade antes de que su comprador abandone el trato.
Claudia recurre a su padre Steve en busca de ayuda cuando teme que la mayor venta de su carrera minera se le esté escapando de las manos.
La tensión surge entre Claudia, Robin y Josh mientras hacen un último intento por cerrar un trato con un comprador de Vietnam.
Mover una enorme losa de jade pone a prueba el antiguo equipo de la mina y la paciencia de Josh.
Arrastrar una roca de 20 toneladas por el peligroso camino para salir de la mina resulta demasiado para su viejo camión 6-Pack.
Robin descubre una enorme lente de jade en Two Mile, pero podría ser demasiado grande para que su pequeña operación la excave.
Cuando una extraña tormenta de nieve en agosto deja a Claudia y Robin varados en Two Mile, Gary y Garon intentan salvar el día conduciendo a través de la tormenta.
Robin toma una decisión difícil sobre su querido camión minero 6-Pack después de otra costosa avería.
Con el invierno acercándose, Claudia lleva a su exhausto equipo al límite, provocando que los ánimos se caldeen.
La nueva temporada minera está llena de sorpresas desagradables, pero un rescate improbable salva el día.
Harto de trabajar para su padre, Josh inicia su propio negocio de transporte por carretera con un semirremolque nuevo.
El camión del ejército muere en el brutal camino hacia la mina.

programmes.t: Imagen Awards & Carin León Controversy! | LatiNation Presents: Desmadre Live!
programmes.d: Welcome to Season 2 of LatiNation Presents: Desmadre Live! We’re kicking off Hispanic Heritage Month with some new faces, hilarious moments, and exclusive guest appearances you don’t want to miss!

programmes.t: The importance of Muscle Beach in Venice, California | Ganadoras
programmes.d: This week on Ganadoras, we’re diving into the history and hype of Muscle Beach in Venice, California.  Our guest, Erika Lorberg  joins us to talk about her bodybuilding career and teaches us how to pose like a champ at the gym.

programmes.t: Best of Your Annoying Prima | The Best of Jenny Lorenzo
programmes.d: You know that cousin who’s always doing too much for no reason? Laritza’s nonstop dramatics, mood swings, and main-character energy somehow turn every minor inconvenience into a full production, bro!
Banda que nos fue presentada por Sounds From Spain en BIME Bilbao Alberto y Garcia nos presentan Flores en el Campoamor, directo grabado en pandemia.
Cuban actress Leslie Lluvet  joins her cuban cousin Humberto Guida and tells her story of survival as her and her family escaped Cuba on a small boat and spent three nights at sea.

programmes.t: Anime Voices, Rolling R's, and Dominican Slang | Cultura Shock
programmes.d: Actress Abby Trott shares how she became the voice for some of the most popular characters in Anime, Mike teaches AK and Kristen how to roll their R's. Artist Jocsan Duran breaks down Dominican slang vs Mexican slang.

Immi'Art 2025 is here! We are joined in the studio by returning local artists, Obed and Jesse, as well as first time participant, Cynthia, who share their healing journey as they express and celebrate their heritage and roots through their work.

programmes.t: Making History Our Own Way | Blacktinidad
programmes.d: We are joined by actor and disability representation activist Jillian Mercado, who shares how she’s taken control of her life and destiny on her own terms. The episode wraps with an exclusive interview with Vergi Rodriguez & singer-songwriter YEИDRY.

programmes.t: Throwing Hands and Pupusas! | Cultura Shock
programmes.d: In this episode, Salvadorian & Mexican pro MMA fighter Tony Cortez of “Combate Global” gives us an in-depth look at what goes into each fight including his strict training diet. Tattoo artist, muralist, and street artist Rask Opticon also joins us.

programmes.d: Amina Zamani, a neuroscientist dedicated to empowering others through brain science, shares her journey and expertise, revealing practical ways to rewire your brain for greater happiness and well-being.

Tess and Alex's relationship is put to the test when a baby is abandoned on his doorstep.
Becky is thrown from her horse and injured when someone takes a shot at her.
It's a dry spell and the women are suffering shared baths, stained washing, and unflushed toilets.
Meg is thrown into turmoil when her first love, ex-husband Kevin (Jodi’s father) returns after 18 years.
Meg is faced with the decision to stay in the place she loves or to leave with the man she loves.
Claire and Peter's growing relationship is leaving Tess feeling more and more isolated from her sister.
Claire and Peter move closer to marriage when he presents her with a ruby pendant.
Claire's relationships are fragmented.
Claire is taking the loss of Peter and Tess badly.
Becky's troublesome older brother Mark returns, determined to drag Sean into his life of illegality.
Frank Da Costa, the new cop in town, has it in for Terry.
With the drought continuing and no money to truck in water, Claire, Tess, and Nick join forces.
Tess motivates Claire into rekindling her dreams of becoming a stock horse trainer and breeder.
Claire and Alex’s business gets off to a rocky start, whilst Nick and Tess form a partnership of their own.
Thieves clean out both Drovers Run and Wilgul, exposing some of the fault lines in the women’s relationships.
Romance is in the air for Jodi as Alberto returns, but Homestay guests bring problems for Tess.
Claire and Alex turns ugly when Peter starts circulating rumours about a secret in Alex’s past.
Claire has to deal with cattle theft and an old adversary.
Tess is on the brink of committing to Nick.
Claire and Tess are shocked to learn Drovers Run is being repossessed, but there’s a greater surprise to come.
Peter puts an astonishing proposition to Claire which will change her life forever.
Claire returns to Drovers Run after her stay in the hospital.
Harry lends Claire his prize bull, which upsets Tess for not being consulted.
Jodi is busy making plans for a big wedding that is becoming too much for Alberto's liking and Meg's finances.
Tess believes Sally is cheating on Nick when she sees her in town with another man.
As a pre-Bucks Night prank, Craig and his mates kidnap Alberto and leave him in the middle of nowhere.
With last-minute wedding preparations underway, Jodi's father blows in unexpectedly.
Becky senses mystery about Jake's past when he convinces her to help him save a prized racehorse from thieves.
Claire uncovers a long-lost treasure which brings back memories of her mother.
The joy surrounding Harry and Liz's 30th wedding anniversary gets shattered.
Relations between Alex and his father take another turn for the worse.
Anticipation is high as Tess's journalist friend is due to arrive at Drovers Run.
Becky feels betrayed when she learns Jake's true identity from his father at the auctions.
The charade of being the father of Claire's baby is causing problems for Alex.
When Jodi receives a mysterious chain letter, she discards it immediately.
Nick and Alex must face the awful truth of their father's new girlfriend.
Mysterious lights are seen by Claire and Tess over Drovers Run.
A mob of Emus descends upon Drovers Run, wreaking havoc on everything they encounter.
Claire's having a naming ceremony for Charlotte Prudence McLeod with her friends & family when Peter arrives.
A young boy lives with an agonizing skin condition.
A man's body blows up like a balloon after a diving accident.
A man is born with his heart outside his rib cage.
A man has surgery on a huge tumor, and a woman with a giant leg finds love.
A man with a crippling skin condition lives life on his own terms.
A man whose body is eating itself hopes surgery can save his life.
Parents of a 44-pound baby try to learn why their son can't stop eating.
A full-face transplant patient battles a second life-threatening challenge.
A mathematician born with severely deformed legs walks on all fours.
A woman hopes a tooth transplant in her eye will stop her from going blind.
A woman's face is slowly being destroyed by a tumor.
Doctors attempt to separate a pair of conjoined twins at the head.
Nick Vujicic was born without arms or legs and his life is about to change.

A family struggles after their daughter is diagnosed with schizophrenia.
A man's nightmares begin intruding into his waking life.
A father with a terrible condition races against time to find a cure.
Conjoined twins Maria and Theresa were declared doomed when they were born.
Follow three sets of conjoined twins and their lives after separation.
Kendra and Maliyah Herrin were born attached at the abdomen and pelvis.

A college student and a businesswoman experience bizarre occurrences.
A father and teenage girl experience bizarre occurrences.
A bedridden doctor and young girl experience bizarre occurrences.
A woman has seizures, and an athlete almost starves starves to death.
A man faces amputation, and a woman is afraid of ordinary objects.
A man can't stop burping, and a model begins to abuse everyone around her.
A woman sweats all the time, and a teacher thinks bugs are all over him.

Joseph's neck lipoma gets in the way of everything he does.
Tiffany has a rare condition that has left her couch bound.
Jorge's case of rhinophyma is so bad that he finds it difficult to breathe.
Ramon's keloids are so large that he may require a skin graft if removed.
Tiana hopes Dr. Mercy can help her get rid of her two extra breasts.
Follow the incredible story of three girls who have stopped aging.
Defying doctors' grim diagnoses, Kenadie focuses on the best possible life.

Three of the tallest teenagers in America discuss their various challenges.
Follow Sultan Kosen of Turkey as he searches for a cure for his gigantism.
Twenty-six-year-old Jyoti is the smallest woman in the world.
Fifty-eight-year-old Ronnie and Donnie Galyon need round-the-clock care.

Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

Where rock 'n' roll swagger meets the weight of metal. This collection bridges the gap, featuring everything from anthemic hard rock to core-shaking classics. It’s loud, it’s proud, and it’s built to move you.

Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.
Action-packed spy thriller about mercenaries out to steal a top-secret briefcase for a mysterious client.
Sean Connery plans to steal a fortune in gold from a railroad payroll car and joins forces with a safecracker.
This riveting tale sees a British publisher and a Russian editor sucked into the dangerous world of espionage.
When murder victims are discovered in Russia's Gorky Park, detective William Hurt is on the case and finds himself in a web of political treachery.
Ernest Borgnine stars as a butcher who gives up on love -- until he meets an equally lonely school teacher.
A widowed nurse (Lucille Ball) and her EIGHT kids get together with a widower (Henry Fonda) and his TEN kids!
Cher, Winona Ryder, and Christina Ricci shine as an unpredictable mother and her two quirky daughters.
A superstitious widow is ready to remarry...until she falls in love with her fiancé's brother!
It's a homespun murder mystery that sees a very pregnant Police Chief on a case kidnapping.
A college boy finds his hometown is not so normal when he discovers a human ear in a field.

Only young Andy realizes that his doll, Chucky, is inhabited by the soul of a killer and is responsible for a spate of gruesome murders. But the real terror begins when Chucky becomes determined to transfer his evil spirit to a human being... Andy!
A psychiatrist's life is terrorized when a killer begins attacking the women in his life.
A sound-effects man witnesses and records a car accident that turns deadly...for him.

programmes.t: The Adventures Of Priscilla, Queen Of The Desert
programmes.d: A wonderfully inventive Australian comedy about three drag performers braving the vast, rugged outback.
To save her family from a farmer's plow, a mild-mannered mouse has a plan to move her house!
A host of stars voice this delightful animated tale of a dog sent back to Earth from Heaven.
Those lovable mutts Charlie and Itchy return for an all new animated, musical adventure!
To prove himself, Igor, a mad scientist's assistant, creates a sweet, show-tune-singing monster.
A wayward teen finds comfort and friendship with the military dog of his deceased older brother.
Ice Cube headlines a stellar cast this hit comedy about a southside Chicago barbershop.
A vicious gang forces Akira to shed his quiet persona and reveal his other identity...that of a skilled Ninja!

When his partner is killed during a drug bust, a federal agent throws away his badge and the rule book with it. Arming himself with an array of deadly weaponry including nunchucks and ninja stars, he sets out to settle the score with the bad guys.
Detective Jack Caine (Dolph Lundgren) thought he;d dealt with every kind of crime on earth, but someone "or something" is using human bodies to manufacture narcotics.
A drug called "Fatal Beauty" has hit the streets of Los Angeles, and tough cop Rita Rizzoli is out to take down the drug lord responsible!

In this nail-biting action film, when an aging hitman (Charles Bronson) takes on an eager apprentice (Jan-Michael Vincent) they become an unmatchable team of killers...until the pupil's ruthlessness puts the two on a deadly collision course!

Cinema tough guy Charles Bronson stars as Majestyk, an ex-con and Vietnam vet, whose efforts to run a farm are thwarted by narrow-minded locals and corrupt cops. But when a Mafia hitman destroys his crop, the farmer's fuse is finally blown.

Breaker! Breaker! stars Chuck Norris at his butt-kicking best as a trucker on a mission to locate his kidnapped brother and bring down a corrupt Judge (George Murdock) who may just have played a role in the disappearance.

Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

Two hapless soldiers of misfortune (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) meet a beautiful girl (Melody Anderson) with a map to a lost gold mine and decide to have one last shot at striking it rich. But the trail to the treasure is no yellow brick road!

Chuck Norris is Lone Wolf McQuade, a Texas Ranger feared by outlaws and respected by other lawmen. When McQuade uncovers a gun smuggling operation, the action explodes, with McQuade wreaking havoc on all those who come between him and the law.

An army of terrorist mercenaries led by Soviet agent Rostov (Richard Lynch) catches America unprepared and makes it into a war zone. Only one man can stem the rising tide of violence: retired agent and martial arts expert Matt Hunter (Chuck Norris).

Chuck Norris stars in this turbo-charged thriller that pits an honest cop against two crime lords and his own department. Henry Silva and Dennis Farina also star in a film that explodes with heart-stopping chases and martial arts confrontations.

Charles Bronson is Leo Kessler, a cynical cop on the trail of Warren Stacy (Gene Davis), a homicidal maniac. When the legal system sets Stacy free, Kessler has one option: to hunt down Stacy on his own before the crazed killer can strike again!

Hard-hitting action, cross-country adventure and a government conspiracy that goes all the way to the top highlight this pulse-pounding political thriller in which Charles Bronson must protect the First Lady (Jill Ireland) from ruthless assassins.

Charles Bronson stars as an LAPD cop framed for murder by Joan Freeman, a vicious ex-con he had put in prison. Going on the run and handcuffed to a foul-mouthed petty thief, he attempts to track down Freeman even as she keeps killing his associates.
Two prison escapees on the lam race against time to find a hidden cache of cash and an incriminating computer disk.

A farm boy (Sean Penn) looking for excitement finds himself on a collision course with his smooth-talking gang leader father (Christopher Walken) in this "powerfully disturbing" (Newsweek) tale based on the story of real-life killer Bruce Johnston.
An undercover cop (Sean Penn) comes back to his old neighborhood in Hell's Kitchen to bring down the Irish Mafia.
Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) grows up to become the reigning head of Harlem's black mafia.
Recovering from an onslaught of bullets that would have killed a lesser man, the Godfather of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs, is back and is out for revenge.
The great Isaac Hayes stars as Truck Turner, who tracks a sadistic pimp through the mean streets of Los Angeles.
A young teenage werewolf (Bruckner) is torn between honoring her family's secret and her love for a man (Dancy).

Struggling actress Mary Steenburgen is offered the film role of a lifetime by the mysterious Roddy McDowall. But all is not as it seems and, as the pieces fall into place, her quest for stardom becomes a fight for survival in this twisty thriller.
When a nine-year-old boy sees the ghost of a girl being murdered, he bravely sets out to solve the crime, but the killer may be closer than he knows!

A hellish hound feeds upon the flesh of the heirs of Baskerville Hall. But before this beast can sink its teeth into the newest lord, it must pit its vicious fangs against the searing intellect of Sherlock Holmes (Peter Cushing) and Dr. Watson.

An English scientist entertains a young American visitor, serving up tea, terror and a beautiful daughter who is soon torn between her father's evil ways and protecting the man she loves. Boris Karloff stars in this H.P. Lovecraft adaptation.

When a beautiful student named Nancy Wagner (Sandra Dee) catches the eye of the weird Wilbur Whateley (Dean Stockwell), her professor uncovers a buried secret and a plot intended to call forth an evil beyond imagination. Daniel Haller directs.
Karen Black, Oliver Reed and Bette Davis star in this chiller as a family is surrounded by an evil  presence that feeds on torture, fear and murder.
In this terrifying sequel, the spirits of the dead are still hell-bent on luring the Freeling's daughter to the other side, where lies only evil!
Nancy Allen, Tom Skerritt, Zelda Rubenstein and Heather O'Rourke star in this suspense-filled conclusion to the terrifying "Poltergeist" trilogy.

Newcomer Steve (James Marsden) is cautioned by Gavin Strick (Nick Stahl) about the Blue Ribbons, a club of robotic, perfect students who rule the school. When Gavin turns into a "perfect" himself, Steve and Rachel Wagner (Katie Holmes) investigate.
When a horror novelist tries to "kill off" his successful author pseudonym, he finds his alter ego on a greusome quest for revenge.
Scott Bakula stars as a detective who gets more than he bargains for in this thriller that rips apart the boundaries between the illusion and magic.
Widowed police psychologist Cal Jamison (Martin Sheen) is forced to deal with a series of ritualistic child murders perpetrated by a rogue cult.
Filled with gripping suspense and eye-popping action, this intense thriller is an unrelenting terror-fest that’ll scare the stuffing out of you!

An evil witch is reincarnated, in modern day New York, in the form of a beautiful Vespa riding punkette. To maintain her eternally youthful status, she must sacrifice a virgin and find a sacred ring which holds tremendous powers.
The demented Doctor Blood thinks he can create the “perfect" human from a corpse. But when he needs a live donor, his neighbors begin to vanish!

programmes.t: The Monster That Challenged The World
programmes.d: The beaches go from fun-filled swim-fests to horrifying slug-fests when gargantuan vampire snails threaten to suck the life out of all mankind!
An American reporter in Japan becomes the unwitting subject of a mad scientist’s twisted experiment in this terrifying tale of ambition gone berserk.

programmes.t: X: The Man With The X-Ray Eyes
programmes.d: In this cult-classic, a driven scientist discovers that his x-ray vision formula brings with it incredible powers…and incredible temptations.

A 300-year old vampire (rock star Adam Ant) tries to "re-humanize" after falling in love with a beautiful "mortal."  His attempts are thwarted, however, by his jealous vampire lover and his new love's jealous fiancee.  Can an ancient vampire find love and happiness in the 20th century?
Every 22 years, a jinxed vampire is fated to lose his beloved at the hands of a crazy pirate. But with his new band, he’s going to end the curse!
Mark wants to go all the way. His girlfriend won’t, but he meets a beautiful vampire who will! The problem? He’s starting to feel a little batty.
After being bitten on the neck during a night of passion, an agent is convinced he's a vampire.

Set in the American West of the 1940s, a pair of little-guy ranchers join forces against the depredations of a ruthless land baron determined to expand his empire at whatever cost. Starring Jane Fonda, James Caan, and Jason Robards.

Twenty years after an unforgivable act, a pioneer has amassed immense wealth and a thriving mining town. But the blind ambition and greed that drove him to succeed finally catch up to him with the unexpected arrival of three apparent strangers.

In this stark, unconventional and powerful western, a ruthless rancher (Robert Ryan) must find a way to save the town of Bitters, Wyoming, its citizenry, and his own soul when a gang of outlaws rides into town. Burl Ives and Tina Louise also star.

When a Mexican gunslinger (Anthony Quinn) rids a town of several notorious gunfighters, he is named the sheriff, but must win over the rest of the residents who are yet to warm to his hard-hitting ways. Katy Jurado and Peter Whitney co-star.

Eli Wakefield (Burt Lancaster) and his son are Kentucky adventurers longing for life on the Texas frontier. They learn, however, that their greatest challenge lies not in the uncharted wilderness, but in the people they meet along the way.
Chaos reigns on the wide open plains as Burt Lancaster and Lee Remick let loose in this comedy that spoofs nearly every convention of movie westerns.

John Huston directs Audrey Hepburn in this thrilling, romantic western about a woman who becomes the target of lawless racism and brutality when it is discovered that she was born to the Kiowa tribe but secretly adopted by a white frontier family.

Kevin Costner, Mary McDonnell and Graham Greene star is this masterpiece that took home 7 Academy Awards, including Best Picture. Sent to protect a U.S. outpost, Lt. John Dunbar (Costner) befriends those he was taught to fear, the Sioux Nation.

From legendary director William Wyler comes this bold, epic western, the story of a ship's captain (Gregory Peck) who ventures west to find a hotbed of jealousy, hatred and dangerous rivalries. Burl Ives won a Supporting Actor Oscar® for his role.

Archie (Gregory Peck) and his partner, Billy (Desi Arnaz, Jr.) are bandits by trade, staging daring robberies throughout the American frontier. But when their latest heist takes a deadly turn, they are pursued by a ruthless marshal (Jack Warden).

A man recently released from a five-year prison sentence seeks vengeance against the former friend who has violated his trust and sought his death. Starring Thomas Hunter, Henry Silva, and Dan Duryea.

Burt Reynolds, Aldo Sambrell and Fernando Rey star in this lusty, gutsy action western about a fearless Indian with a relentless vendetta against the band of outlaws that killed his people. Directed by Spaghetti Western legend Sergio Corbucci.

Set against the 1912 Mexican Revolution, Captain Rod Douglas (George Peppard) leads a small band of misfits into Mexican territory to destroy six cannons, stolen by bloodthirsty revolutionaries and their infamous leader Hector Cordoba (Raf Vallone).

When a small town on the Paria River is decimated by a group of vile outlaws, the bandits get more than they bargained for after the local bargeman turns the tables on the vicious gang! Lee van Cleef and Warren Oates star in this rousing western.

Lee Van Cleef and  John Phillip Law star in this bona fide Spaghetti Western classic as, fifteen years after bandits massacred his family, a young man seeking revenge forms an unlikely alliance with the outlaw who was framed for the murders.

Mercenary Sergei Kowalski (Franco Nero) joins up with a Mexican revolutionary Paco Roman (Tony Musante) to rob a silver mine and bring new order to Mexico by force! Jack Palance and Giovanna Ralli co-star in this brilliant spaghetti western.

The results are explosive when an Irish terrorist (James Coburn) with a dynamite obsession teams up with a Mexican peasant-turned- revolutionary (Rod Steiger) in this action-packed tale of power and politics. Directed by the legendary Sergio Leone.

programmes.t: A Reason To Live, A Reason To Die
programmes.d: From director Tonino Valerii comes this top-notch spaghetti western set during the Civil War where eight condemned Union prisoners attempt to capture a Missouri fort from Confederate soldiers. James Coburn, Telly Savalas and Bud Spencer star.

Host Lisa Garr interviews Professor Robert Thurman, the preeminent scholar and interpreter of Tibetan Buddhist philosophy for the modern world, who believes that Wisdom is Bliss and in fact, that’s the name of his latest book. Thurman is a very close friend of HH Dalai Lama and today he discusses deep ideas about mindfulness and presence and leads us on a joyful exploration into the nature of reality through Buddha’s threefold curriculum.

Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr. Harley Rotbart, a nationally renowned infectious diseases specialist, pediatrician, parenting expert, speaker, and educator who discusses his latest book No Regrets Parenting: Turning Long Days and Short Years into Cherished Moments with Your Kids. He shares special keys for parents to guide children to live a life of wonder and contentment by conscious parenting.

Host Lisa Garr interviews marital and family psychologist Dr. Michael Tobin who believes the secret to a happy, long-lasting relationship is mutual respect for one another. He’s been with his life partner, soulmate, and wife, Deborah, for 47 years, and in practice as a psychologist for more than 45 years. His most recent book, Riding the Edge, A Love Song to Deborah, chronicles his six-month transformative journey.

Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr. James Greenblatt, a pioneer in the field of integrative medicine who has been treating patients with eating disorders for many decades. His nutritional approach to psychiatry is revolutionary and has helped patients worldwide. He is the author of seven books, including Answers to Anorexia and Finally Focused: The Breakthrough Natural Treatment Plan for ADHD.

Qigong is considered one of the five branches of Chinese Medicine, a foundational basis for martial arts, and a long-standing spiritual practice revered in Daoist and Zen traditions. In this video, your qigong teacher, Mimi Kuo-Deemer, introduces you to the etymology of qigong and the history of the 8 Silk Brocades you will practice in this course.
Let any burdens you carry drop away while you move through this gentle, intentional qigong practice.

This practice begins by tending to both the Yin and Yang meridians in your body. You’ll start with a soothing self-massage, which is beneficial to the health of your vagus nerve, especially if you experience overwhelm or often feel depleted. Allow yourself to feel calm and bright as you practice the fifth and sixth Silk Brocades.

As humans, we are constantly struggling between the poles of what we think we want and what is. When we lose touch with the truth of what is, we create and compound our suffering. What narratives are you constructing? Are they in conflict with the truth of the situation? Are you struggling with what is?

The way you recall a memory and the way it actually happened might be completely different. The question is, do you know which version feeds you? We can become so wrapped up in our recollections, we convince ourselves of these untruths. Is that person a monster? Were they wishing you harm? Or were they dealing with a difficult situation in the best way they knew how?

Stop focusing on the object of your desires and start focusing on the reason for desiring that object in the first place. When you turn it around, you may find that what you really want is completely different than what you’ve been telling yourself.

A single thought plants the seed of a narrative. You feel lonely and unsupported, so, of course, someone must have abandoned you. Over time, the thought “I feel abandoned” grows into the story of an entire childhood. Let’s uproot the thought and untangle the story.

Fear is a fickle partner. While it certainly serves a purpose — keeping us out of danger and forcing us to question our assumptions — if we give too much of ourselves over to fear, it will lead us down paths filled with insecurity, broken social interactions, and a persistent struggle against the way things actually are.
Definitive statements are comforting. They give life structure and clear direction. But what happens when your declarations are at odds with your subconscious desires?

Today's lesson is a bit of a reality check, as we'll begin to question the current way we look at relationships, romantic or not. How we see ourselves and our relationship to God influences our view of our relationships with other people. Today we're going to examine that view from a place of love.

A miracle happens when you stop thinking with fear and start thinking with love. Your greatest power lies in your mind. To establish stronger connections, you need to go into every situation requesting to be an instrument of love. When you approach your interactions with love, you'll begin to have more miraculous relationships.

In the following lesson, we'll discover how the ego mind influences both our way of thinking and our relationships. We'll also identify the unconscious barriers we've built that cause us to form these judgments and thoughts. That's where the problem is, and that's where the solution lies.

The focus of today's lecture is this: atonement. While we decided to act a certain way in the past based on our personality, we can now use this information to improve our current and future relationships.

To truly grasp the concept of forgiveness, we have to be willing to see past the person's mistakes. The benefit we get from being more forgiving isn't that other people are going to be more forgiving towards us, it's that it won't affect us when they aren't.
In this lesson, we'll discover the significance of holy relationships. After all, souls are brought together for the purpose of enlightenment.
